description:
Check if a Kling generation task is complete.

WHEN TO CALL:
- After any generate_* / extend_* tool returns a task_id
- Wait ~30 seconds between checks
- Keep polling until status is "succeed" or "failed"

TASK TYPES: "text2video" (generate_kling_video), "image2video" (generate_kling_image_to_video), "video-extend" (extend_kling_video), "lip-sync" (generate_kling_lip_sync), "image" (generate_kling_image).

RESPONSE STATUS VALUES:
- "submitted" → Task received, generation starting
- "processing" → Being generated (wait and poll again)
- "succeed" → DONE! Response includes the result URL(s) and, for videos, the video id (needed by extend_kling_video / generate_kling_lip_sync)
- "failed" → Error occurred, check the error message

RESULT URLs: Valid for 30 days after generation — use download_kling_video to save anything you want to keep.

task_id.description: The task_id returned by a generate_* or extend_* tool

task_type.description: "text2video" for generate_kling_video, "image2video" for generate_kling_image_to_video, "video-extend" for extend_kling_video, "lip-sync" for generate_kling_lip_sync, "image" for generate_kling_image. Default: text2video

name: check_kling_task
